verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a browsable model catalog page (cerebras-docs-21, cerebras-docs-27) and claims OpenAI API compatibility (cerebras-docs-3, cerebras-docs-4, cerebras-docs-23), which typically includes a GET /v1/models endpoint, but no evidence explicitly documents such an endpoint or its response schema, and an OpenAPI/spec probe returned 404s (cerebras-probe-3). missing for 10: explicit docs for a GET /v1/models endpoint, example request/response, and confirmation it's part of the public API surface rather than just a doc page.
